$meta.purpose: COMPLETE, 281 of 281 rows. Supersedes both the 2026-08-18 partial capture (89 rows) and the first 2026-08-19 batch (rows 1-196 only) -- this file is the full and final table.

inputs.detail: Full URL for ui_row 29 ('Audio Trace') supplied directly by user after the screenshot batch, resolving the previously-unreadable tooltip-obscured cell.

$meta.truncation_meaning: Trailing '...' means the value was cut off by the column's fixed width in the live UI itself (visible ellipsis in the screenshot), not a transcription shortcut. Per-row list in _truncated_fields. Occurs on ui_row 217, 240, 241, 242, 247, 248, 254, 255, 256, 257, 259, 266, 273, 276, 279 (Name and/or URL/Product Reference columns).
$meta.row_key: not exposed in this view -- same gap as every capture of this table so far

completeness.basis: Matches Products.resource_ids' count of 281 distinct child references exactly. AppSheet's 'Add row' affordance appears immediately after ui_row 281 with no further rows.

known_gaps: Row key (AppSheet UNIQUEID) is not exposed in this view for any row. The parent->child join from Products.resource_ids to this table cannot be reconstructed from these captures alone -- same limitation noted on every other table lacking a Row ID column.
ui_row 274 has a genuinely empty url cell (not truncated -- no link renders at all in either capture). Whether this is a real data gap or an intentional placeholder is unknown.
data_anomalies: DUPLICATE CONTENT UNDER TWO PRODUCT REFERENCES (i-Ready): ui_row 124-128, 137-139, 142-146 ('[OLD] i-Ready Inform (formerly i-Ready Diagnostic)' / '[OLD] i-Ready Personalized Learning') carry identical URLs to ui_row 181-190, 212-214 ('i-Ready Inform', no OLD prefix). Looks like leftover rows from a product rename/split in AppSheet. Whether the OLD-prefixed rows should migrate at all is an open question for the architecture doc.

DUPLICATE CONTENT UNDER TWO PRODUCT REFERENCES (CommonLit): ui_row 217 ('CommonLit 360') and ui_row 280 ('CommonLit Text Library') point at the same URL (support.commonlit.org/article/437-...) with slightly different Name wording. Same pattern as the i-Ready case -- recorded as observed, not merged.
ui_row 102 has no Label value despite being a YouTube video, inconsistent with the Label='Video' pattern used elsewhere.
ui_row 222, 244, 246 have no Source value at all (neither Internal nor External chip rendered) -- genuinely blank, not a capture gap.
Name is non-distinct on 13 of 281 rows -- not usable as a key on its own.

DATETIME RANGE NOTE: this table's last-updated values now span 2/17/26 through 8/7/26, i.e. some rows were added/edited on the same day as this capture (2026-08-19's adjacent date, 8/7/26) -- confirms this table is still actively maintained, not a frozen legacy export.

columns.name: product_reference
columns.notes: Stores the product NAME, matching Products.product_name -- except the '[OLD]'-prefixed values, which are themselves truncated and do not match any current Products.product_name.

columns.notes: Maps to ListingData.ResourceLink.url. ui_row 274 empty (see known_gaps); ui_row 29 supplied directly by user.

columns.name: source
columns.notes: THE SPLIT RULE: Internal -> ListingData.vendor_resources; External -> ListingData.other_resources. 3 rows have neither value set.

columns.name: label
columns.notes: Sparse across the full table. Only 'Video' and 'Statement/Policy' observed.

columns.name: added_to_site
columns.notes: Publication gate. Every one of the 281 rows is explicitly Y or N -- no blank/tri-state anywhere in this table, unlike some others in the family.

columns.name: notes
columns.notes: Editorial commentary -- concentrated in the later-added rows (216+); largely absent in the earliest rows (1-215 had almost none). Frequently explains why a row is unchecked (vendor-requested removal, reviewer flag) but sometimes just incidental commentary on a checked row.
